artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: rows_for_run(root) rebuilds the induction request FRESH via induction_request.measure_population + induction_request.build_request over the backlog the universe carries UNRESOLVED (never choose_population's RESOLVED_ABSENT branch, never a stored induction_request.json). ISSUER AMENDMENT 1: BEFORE any call, effective_state_and_reason(row) reclassifies an EVIDENCED row to the local STATE_DISAGREEMENT when parse_folder_token(folder) finds the folder's own trailing Bloomberg token pair and it DIFFERS from the report's parsed root (reason 'folder_token X report_token Y no third source'); a folder with no such trailing pair, or one whose token AGREES, is unchanged. run(rows, as_of, call, stdout) calls ONE ['--folder', folder, '--as-of', as_of, '--write-pool'] per row whose EFFECTIVE state is EVIDENCED via an injected call(argv)->rc (default add_security.main), parses the outcome from add_security's OWN printed-line grammar (already-registered:/REFUSED:/MEASURED:/UNRESOLVED: prefixes), never calls a DISAGREEMENT/AMBIGUOUS/NO_EVIDENCE/other row, and prints the totals line (now carrying a `disagreement` token) FIRST and LAST. make_fake_call(rows) scripts registered/already-registered/refused across the first three EFFECTIVELY-evidenced folders (a row headed for DISAGREEMENT is never scripted, since it is never called). --fire is refused unless OPAL_INDUCTION_FIRE=1, --as-of names today (UTC), and the process is not under pytest -- fire_permitted() is the pure gate, tested directly; main()'s --fire branch checks it before ever calling library.library_root(). Measured on the real 93-folder library via --dry-run --as-of 2026-09-24 (run twice, identical both times): population 60 evidenced 20 ambiguous 2 (Copa CPA, Uber Technologies UBER US, existing security_key collisions) disagreement 1 (America Movil AXMB MM: folder token AXMB, report token AMXB) other 37 called 20 registered 18 already_registered 1 refused 1 errors 0 bloomberg_calls 0 sum 60.

15 tests, offline, under tests/conftest.py's autouse poison (boto3.client/resource/Session.client, subprocess.run/Popen, socket.create_connection) plus an explicit save/restore positive control on add_security._load_blp_client (the one site conftest does not cover): (1) rows_for_run's wiring; (2) run() calling only EFFECTIVELY-EVIDENCED rows and parsing every outcome branch (registered/already-registered/refused/unresolved/error) from a hand-scripted call reproducing add_security's own printed-line grammar, with totals math (E+A+D+O=P, called=evidenced) and totals-FIRST-and-LAST; (2a, ISSUER AMENDMENT 1) parse_folder_token agrees/disagrees/absent (Nestle NESN SW agrees, America Movil AXMB MM disagrees, UBS/JD.com 9618 HK/British American Tobacco carry no trailing pair), effective_state_and_reason on an agreeing row (unchanged EVIDENCED), a disagreeing row (DISAGREEMENT, reason 'folder_token AXMB report_token AMXB no third source'), a no-pair row (unchanged EVIDENCED) and a non-EVIDENCED row (untouched), and run() itself reclassifying America Movil AXMB MM to DISAGREEMENT and never calling it (a scripted call that raises AssertionError on any folder it was not told to expect proves this -- calling America Movil would raise); (3) make_fake_call scripting every branch (registered/already-registered/refused) with bloomberg_calls 0 and argv recorded; (4) the add_security._load_blp_client poison positive control (raises, counts, resets); (5) fire_permitted's four gate combinations; (6) main()'s --fire refusal end-to-end without the env var, with the env var set (still refused, running under pytest), and with a non-today as-of, plus --as-of format validation (rc 2) -- none of these six touch library.library_root().
